# Another Dungeon: how it works

Source: anothereden.wiki, page "Another Dungeon" (saved 2026-11-20, revision 342027). Facts
only; no game art. The page shows key cards and tickets as icons: here green key card = the
Hard key, red key card = the Very Hard key (the "2x Green Key" dungeons spend two green ones).
Every dungeon's level, era and drops: [another-dungeon-list.md](another-dungeon-list.md).

## Unlocking and difficulties

- Unlocks after Chapter 10. Entered from the Spacetime Rift by talking to the Nameless Girl
  next to the Blue Door.
- Harder versions of places already cleared, with level-boosted enemies that drop materials
  for new equipment.
- Hard is the only difficulty until Chapter 25 is cleared; then Very Hard unlocks for a
  dungeon whose Hard was cleared first. Side-story dungeons unlock with their story instead.

## Keys

- A run costs 1-2 key cards: normally 1 green (Hard) or 1 red (Very Hard). Some dungeons take
  2 green, and usually bring their own mechanics.
- The Phantom Crystal Dimension takes no key card: it uses a White Key.
- A key card is restored every 6 hours, starting at the daily reset (15:00 UTC).
- Other ways to get key cards: 20 Chronos Stones buy one (premium currency: the macros never
  do this); a chance from the Cat Scratchbook; 5 Tsubura's Gems each at the Nopaew Emporium
  (weekly stock 10, restocked Tuesdays 3:00 UTC); 20 of each from a merchant in ARAT Maze
  Village.
- Soft limit 5-12 per colour (depends on the key type and the premium subscription). Above
  it, the daily restock stops. The counter shows at most 999.

## Restrictions inside

- The menu only offers: Party (reorder the party brought in; no swaps, sidekicks fixed, no
  equipment or skill changes), Food, Quit (leave the dungeon) and Other (settings).
- Each map allows 5 battles (running away counts). Then "The enemy has disappeared..." shows
  and no more enemies come on that map. Some dungeons change the limit: every 2x green key
  dungeon, Home's Lost Atelier and Toto Theater World, among others.

## White Key

- At the end of any run (any dungeon, any difficulty), a 10% chance of a White Key. It opens
  the Phantom Crystal Dimension (large amounts of Git, EXP scrolls and Scripts).
- Only one White Key can be held at a time.
- A run skipped with a Cat Express Ticket can also give it (10%).

## Rare maps

- Maps 2 and 3 can turn rare: same layout, another name, better Memoir drops from chests,
  and on some a Rare Horror with its own material.
- Chances: 79% both normal, 10% only map 2 rare, 10% only map 3 rare, 1% both.
- Horrors only appear on maps 1 and 2, so Rare Horrors only on a rare map 2 (about 11%).
- Rare map names per dungeon and the Rare Horrors:
  [another-dungeon-rare-maps.md](another-dungeon-rare-maps.md); the per-dungeon pages in
  [dungeons/](dungeons/) list their own.

## Completion rewards

- 0 to 3 rewards, by the party's total Light points or total Shadow points (not added
  together). The 3rd reward of each dungeon is Light- or Shadow-based (see the list).

| Difficulty | 1st | 2nd | 3rd |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hard | none needed | 24+ | 96+ |
| Very Hard | 24+ | 60+ | 120+ |
| Otherlands Area 4, Hard | 24+ | 60+ | 120+ |
| Otherlands Area 4, Very Hard | 48+ | 120+ | 180+ |

- Present, Antiquity and Future Garulea, Underworld, Omegapolis, Entrana, Jasmond and Edax
  give up to 5 rewards: 24+ / 60+ / 120+ / 240+ / 360+.
- Badges: each reward line has its own main stats per dungeon
  ([another-dungeon-rewards.md](another-dungeon-rewards.md); the per-dungeon pages list
  theirs). The sub stat is any other stat or none.

## Story characters' Light/Shadow

- A story character in the party (front line or not, alive or not, any style) has a chance to
  gain 1 Light/Shadow point in their own dungeon: 10% on Hard, 20% on Very Hard, 25% in 2x green
  key dungeons.
- It happens on the "Congratulations" screen after the rewards, with its own animation
  (Toto Theater World: before leaving the dungeon). Each dungeon page names its character
  ("Story Character Light/Shadow Points"); all pairs:
  [another-dungeon-rewards.md](another-dungeon-rewards.md#story-characters-lightshadow-by-dungeon).
- Free characters below 255 can also gain it in Toto Theater World (about 24.8% per red key).

## Tsubura's Gems

- 10 Gems for each Very Hard run or 2-key run, at most 120 a week. Traded at the Nopaew
  Emporium for rare items such as Chant Scripts.

## Cat Express Ticket (Skip)

- Spent with the normal key cost on an already cleared dungeon to skip straight to the clear
  screen: normal clear rewards, chest loot and enemy materials, Light/Shadow points where the
  dungeon gives them, Horror drops once that Horror was beaten (Rare Horror drops too, when the
  roll gave its rare map), and the 10% White Key chance.
- A skip counts toward the Nameless Girl's clear count (the Another Dungeon clears needed to
  unlock her) and toward Astral Archive's Another Dungeon clear task and the Trials of
  Cultivation. It does not count enemy kills for Astral Archive, Battle Awards or the monthly
  Trials.
- Not with a ticket: EXP and Git from battles, some drop-limited items (Black Pearls,
  Uninspiring Ax, Metallic Maiden's Bone), Phase Shifts and Phase Crystals, and routes that need
  items or conditions. Episode key item bonuses don't apply. Enemies that respawn without end
  give an amount in a fixed range.
- Dungeons with a choice of route: after beating the bosses at the end of those routes and
  clearing, those routes can be skipped. Otherlands: the items of every boss beaten in the
  region come with the skip, whichever area was chosen.
- Garulea/Underworld/Hollow currency is capped at 999 while skipping, until spent in the
  dungeon (it can overflow if skipping goes on at 999).
- Otherlands: Hard and Very Hard both take 2 tickets, no completion rewards, only Areas 1-3.
  Kairos: only Level 4 destinations.
- Tickets: monthly from the Guide of the Heavens and Guide of the Land, campaigns and events,
  the Cat Scratchbook, and 1-5 from the Phantom Crystal Dimension. Soft limit 50 (above it the
  guides stop restocking).
- Eligible: most dungeons (the page's "List of Eligible Dungeons"). Not eligible: Sealed Realm
  (Transitory and Ephemeral Time Space), Home's Lost Atelier, Otherlands Area 4, Ruins of
  Rucyana, Toto Theater World.

## Otherlands

- Opened after Chapter 25, from the Another Dungeon menu. Each region has areas 1-4; each area
  has a number of bosses to beat before the next unlocks. Same 5-battle limit per map.
- Shiny monsters give very rare upgrade drops and tend to run away.
- No completion rewards in areas 1-3; area 4 (one chest and a boss) gives them with the higher
  Light/Shadow thresholds above.
